blocks.text: IPv6 mein 4 hexadecimal digits (0-9 aur a-f wale digits) ke 8 groups hote hain, aur beech mein colons (:) hote hain.

blocks.caption: IPv6 ke hisse
rows: ISP ya ilaqa, jaise “Pakistan, Sindh, Karachi”
ISP ke andar aap ka local network, jaise “Gulshan area”
Aap ka khaas device, jaise “Your laptop”

blocks.alt: IPv4 192.168.1.10 ke chaar hisse: 192, 168 aur 1 network part, 10 host part (32 bits). IPv6 ke aath groups: 2001 0db8 85a3 global routing prefix (ISP ya ilaqa), 0000 subnet ID (local network), 0000 8a2e 0370 7334 interface ID (aap ka device) (128 bits).

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text:
• IPv6 ke kul addresses: 2¹²⁸ ≈ 3.4 × 10³⁸.
• Yeh itna bara number hai ke IPv6 ke addresses amalan (practically) kabhi khatam nahi honge.
Yeh program IPv6 address ke groups ginta hai, bits ka hisaab lagata hai aur teen hisse alag karta hai. address badal kar Run karein.

address = "2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334"

groups = address.split(":")
print("Groups:", len(groups))
print("Bits in one group:", len(groups[0]) * 4)
print("Total bits:", len(groups) * 16)
print("Global routing prefix:", ":".join(groups[:3]))
print("Subnet ID:", groups[3])
print("Interface ID:", ":".join(groups[4:]))
print("Total IPv6 addresses:", 2 ** 128)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"groups = address.split(":")": address ko colons par tor kar 8 groups ki list banata hai.
"len(groups)": groups ki ginti = 8.
"len(groups[0]) * 4": ek group mein 4 hexadecimal digits hain aur har hexadecimal digit 4 bits ka hai, is liye 4 x 4 = 16 bits.
"len(groups) * 16": 8 x 16 = 128 bits.
"groups[:3]": pehle teen groups = global routing prefix; "groups[3]" = subnet ID; "groups[4:]" = aakhri chaar groups = interface ID.
"2 ** 128": 128 bits se ban'ne wale kul addresses.
Output: "Groups: 8", "Bits in one group: 16", "Total bits: 128", "Global routing prefix: 2001:0db8:85a3", "Subnet ID: 0000", "Interface ID: 0000:8a2e:0370:7334", "Total IPv6 addresses: 340282366920938463463374607431768211456" (taqreeban 3.4 × 10³⁸).
Khud try karein: address mein aakhri group 7334 ko 0001 kar ke Run karein: sirf Interface ID badalta hai, baqi hisse wohi rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: IPv6 address mein kitne groups hain, har group kitne bits ka hai, aur kul bits kitne hain?
blocks.explanation: 8 groups, har group 16 bits (4 hexadecimal digits), kul 8 x 16 = 128 bits.

items: IPv6: 4 hexadecimal digits ke 8 groups, colons se alag; har group 16 bits; kul 128 bits; 2¹²⁸ ≈ 3.4 × 10³⁸ addresses.
